task: Regenerate the symbol lists blaze-link ships (glibc by release, libSystem)
do: glibc: put each release's sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/{x86_64/64,aarch64}/*.abilist (older tags: .../nptl/, ports/...) under <dir>/<release>/<arch>/<lib>.abilist with <dir>/commits.json (release to tag commit, as crates/blaze-link/src/target/shipped/glibc-commits.json), then `blaze run -q -p scripts --bin cross -- '{"command": "glibc-list", "abilists": "<dir>", "write": true}'`. libSystem: on a Mac, `... '{"command": "darwin-list", "sdk": "$(xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path)", "write": true}'`, and set MACOS_SDK in target/shipped.rs to that SDK's version. Without `write` both compare and fail on a difference.
why: The lists are bytes of the blaze binary and inputs of every link of Rust alone; a hand edit would not be reproducible. The files in the tree on 2026-11-12 were written by a Python prototype of the same algorithm, since a lane may not build: the first run of the Rust generator must show it writes the same bytes.
